name: task-pipeline-skill
description: Full-cycle task delivery pipeline orchestrator skill for Claude Code — a mandatory built-in intake grill + 9 gated stages (docs, brainstorm, spec, plan, build, tests, deploy, post-deploy, docs/wiki) whose doctrine ships inside the skill with no required companion plugin, plus a super-ux UX track for user-facing tasks and toggleable release automation. This package is the installer CLI.
author: ssheleg
